annotations.title: Zero-PII Physical Surface-BRDF & Spectral Optical Scan Enrollment

description: Enrolls a zero-PII physical surface-BRDF microtopography and 8-band VNIR/SWIR pigment spectral descriptor pair (baseline_descriptor + intake_descriptor) into the append-only Ariadne Nexus optical forensics ledger (ANX-RFC-001). Enforces genesis baseline immutability, verifies optional ariadne-hash-optical SHA-256 commitments, and returns a deterministic basis-point concordance breakdown. Use when: registering a conservation lab or freeport scan before calling generate_zk_provenance_proof or batch_underwrite_portfolio. Do not use when: generating a signed ZK certificate (use generate_zk_provenance_proof instead) or checking manifest schema (use inspect_manifest_schema instead). Behavior: Idempotent append-only write requiring an active X-API-Key at $0.00 meter charge (60 RPM; rejects conflicting genesis baselines with HTTP 409).

asset_id.description: Non-PII collateral asset identifier (3-64 alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen/colon chars).

baseline_descriptor.description: Immutable genesis or initial freeport intake physical optical scan descriptor.

anisotropy_ratio_micro.description: Azimuthal brushwork anisotropy ratio in micro-units (0-1000000).

beckmann_roughness_micro.description: Cook-Torrance/Beckmann RMS microfacet slope roughness in micro-units (10000-950000).

craquelure_junction_density_per_cm2_mill.description: Craquelure network junction density per cm^2 in milli-units (0-500000).

fresnel_f0_micro.description: Normal-incidence Fresnel specular reflectance F0 in micro-units (10000-250000).

retouch_uv_anomaly_area_bps.description: UV-fluorescence or IR-transmittance modern overpaint area in basis points (0-10000).

spectral_reflectance_8band.description: 8-band VNIR/SWIR reflectance vector (450nm-1650nm) in integer units (1-100000).

expected_optical_scan_sha256.description: Optional 32-byte SHA-256 hex digest pre-computed locally via ariadne-hash-optical.

intake_descriptor.description: Current conservation lab or freeport inspection optical scan descriptor.

anisotropy_ratio_micro.description: Azimuthal brushwork anisotropy ratio in micro-units (0-1000000).

beckmann_roughness_micro.description: Cook-Torrance/Beckmann RMS microfacet slope roughness in micro-units (10000-950000).

craquelure_junction_density_per_cm2_mill.description: Craquelure network junction density per cm^2 in milli-units (0-500000).

fresnel_f0_micro.description: Normal-incidence Fresnel specular reflectance F0 in micro-units (10000-250000).

retouch_uv_anomaly_area_bps.description: UV-fluorescence or IR-transmittance modern overpaint area in basis points (0-10000).

spectral_reflectance_8band.description: 8-band VNIR/SWIR reflectance vector (450nm-1650nm) in integer units (1-100000).

scanner_facility_ref.description: Optional non-PII conservation lab or freeport bay code (e.g. "GVA-FREEPORT-BAY-04").

name: enroll_optical_scan

baseline_newly_created.description: True if this call created the asset's genesis baseline row; false on idempotent match.

baseline_sha256.description: 0x-prefixed canonical SHA-256 commitment of the immutable genesis baseline.

concordance_preview.description: Deterministic fixed-point physical optical concordance breakdown.

brdf_microtopography_bps.description: Raking-light Cook-Torrance/Beckmann BRDF concordance in basis points.

composite_score_bps.description: Composite weighted optical concordance score in basis points (0-10000).

craquelure_structural_bps.description: Craquelure network topology concordance in basis points.

pigment_spectral_sam_bps.description: Illumination-invariant 8-band VNIR/SWIR Spectral Angle Mapper concordance in bps.

uv_retouch_penalty_bps.description: UV/IR modern overpaint basis-point haircut subtracted from composite score.

enrolled.description: Always true when baseline and intake scan commitments are durably enrolled.

intake_newly_created.description: True if this call inserted a new intake scan row; false on idempotent retry.

optical_scan_sha256.description: 0x-prefixed canonical SHA-256 commitment of the enrolled intake scan.

verified_caller_sa.description: Verified internal VPC OIDC caller service account or canary label.
